title: Astor vs. Wealthfront: an AI investing agent or a robo-advisor?
summary: Wealthfront runs an automated index portfolio for 0.25% a year. Astor watches the accounts you already have, and you make every decision.
body_markdown:
### Is Astor a robo-advisor?


No. A robo-advisor like Wealthfront manages a portfolio with discretion, which means it decides what to buy and sell inside the account. Astor is a personal investing agent and an SEC-registered investment adviser that gives personalized advice about the accounts you already have. You make every decision, and Astor never trades, rebalances or manages money for you.


### How much does Wealthfront cost?


As of October 2026, Wealthfront charges 0.25% a year for its Automated Investing Account, which needs $500 to open, and the ETFs in the portfolio have their own expense ratios on top. Its Stock Investing Account has no out-of-pocket advisory fee. Wealthfront says that fee is paid out of the interest margin it earns on the Cash Account those clients are required to keep.


### Can I use Astor and Wealthfront together?


Yes, since they do different jobs. You could keep a managed index portfolio as a hands-off core and a separate brokerage account for the stocks you pick yourself. Astor is built for the part you manage yourself.


### Does Astor move my money?


No. Astor can see your holdings but can’t move money, and you don’t transfer anything to Astor. The one place an order can be placed is Text to Trade, and only in your own Robinhood agentic account, with the money you set aside for it, after you approve each trade.


### Is Wealthfront a fiduciary?


Wealthfront Advisers LLC is registered with the SEC as an investment adviser, and its Form CRS says that when it acts as your adviser it has to act in your best interest and put your interests ahead of its own. Astor is also an SEC-registered investment adviser and owes clients a fiduciary duty. You can look up either firm on the SEC’s[Investment Adviser Public Disclosure](https://adviserinfo.sec.gov/) site.
